name: manual_da2658
claim: When a Git or GitHub operation is rejected before the command launches, diagnose the execution approval/control layer separately; repository hooks cannot cause or fix pre-launch policy-schema failures.

decisions.notes: This session repeatedly surfaced an approval-service unknown_parameter error before gh executed. Treating it as a Git, gh, authentication, or hook failure caused unnecessary retries and obscured the actual boundary.
